system.description:
The ship-board shooters of the Opal Isles and the Jinia seas, who learned to fight in the chaos of boarding actions: close quarters, many targets, no room to reload.

  • Close Quarters: no Disadvantage on ranged attacks from an enemy within 5ft of you (Close quarters, in The Arneyan Codex).
    • 9th level: when you hit a creature within 10ft with a firearm, it makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or is pushed 5ft.
  • Sea Dog: Advantage on Seamanship checks, and on Intimidation checks when visibly armed with firearms.
